sections.heading: Amity Patna vs Arcade Business College for BCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity Patna if you want a recorded fee of ₹1.08 lakh, in a private BCA setting at Patna.
Choose Arcade Business College only after you have checked the official BCA brochure, because our records for fees or placements on this page are thin.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹1.08 lakh as a tuition figure for Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) at Amity Patna. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Arcade Business College that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amity Patna or Arcade Business College?
